note: Reproducible baseline for the clean production port. Every value is read from the running system at generation time, not transcribed. The git SHA below is the commit this describes; the baseline TAG is applied to the commit that adds this file, one later.

git.describes_commit_subject: Closeout: invariants 17-18 asserted, runtime independence guarded, Â§14 smoke test

stage0.model: curated eligibility registry; no formula may add a company

stage1.valuation_history_semantics: ALL point-in-time visible history available as of the decision date, subject to the existing minimum-history requirement. NOT truncated to a trailing 10-year or other rolling window (§13.2, frozen 2026-08-14).

stage2.max_age_semantics: Evidence-freshness gate for NEW exposure, not a thesis-expiration timer. The thesis of record survives until trim or explicit closure; stale evidence suspends adds and reopened episodes only, and can never itself cause a sale (§13.11, frozen 2026-08-14).

stage4_ladder.cap_semantics: cap3 is per LIVE LADDER EPISODE, not per Stage-2 thesis label. One thesis may fund more than three lots across inactivity-separated episodes.
stage4_ladder.revalidation_before_each_add: structural — rows rebuilt and Stage 2 re-run before the ladder

stage5_trim.rule: BOTH legs: price >= the name's own sell line (its valuation basis at sell_percentile of its OWN history) AND price >= an optimistic owner-earnings DCF ceiling. History-leg-only fallback where no DCF anchor exists.
stage5_trim.status: REVIEW SIGNAL ONLY — automatic execution not authorized (frozen 2026-08-14)

sleeves.reserve_definition: The A reserve is SPY only. A funds positions by selling SPY from its own reserve and never by touching B.
sleeves.rebalance_policy: no scheduled rebalance; sleeves drift, contributions split at target
sleeves.legacy_qqq_treatment: The pre-existing QQQ block is NOT sold. Removing QQQ from [reserve.weights] makes it unreachable by the sweep and by _fund_from_reserve, so it stops being spendable by A and becomes the legacy seed of the protected B sleeve. Sleeves converge on contributions alone.

mechanism_b.definition: QQQ union MGK, resolved to canonical securities, ranked by point-in-time market cap, top N
mechanism_b.weighting: cap-weighted on IMPLIED SHARES (marketcap / price from the same row)
mechanism_b.on_gap: pool left exactly as it was; carry forward unchanged
mechanism_b.reserve: none — fully invested from the first confirmed snapshot
mechanism_b.reconstitution_policy: Mechanism-B reconstitution: MONTHLY (frozen 2026-08-14). Rebuild on the first trading opportunity after a COMPLETE confirmed monthly QQQ + MGK snapshot; rank the union by current market cap, take the top 25, establish implied-share units. Units are then fixed and weights price-drift until the next reconstitution. If either source is missing or incomplete, the prior portfolio is carried forward unchanged. No partial and no intra-month reconstitutions.

provisional: Stage-2 v1 model selection remains a prospective-validation decision; [stage2] records what is in force today, not a blessed choice.
Trim automatic execution is deliberately unauthorized.
Sleeves sit near 50/50 against the 67/33 target and converge on contributions only.
Mechanism B holds the legacy QQQ block plus whatever B25 contributions build; it is not yet a pure B25 basket.
